marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Ose (Dominique Sanda) is the owner of a nursing home on a hilltop in Pasundan Land, when the Dutch still controlled the Republic of Indonesia. After changing the times, the homes were abandoned, and by the surrounding villagers were known as Villa Rose inherited to Sarah (Atiqah Hasiholan). Sarah lives in the Netherlands. After marrying Jonathan (Bob Steven), Sarah wants to return fully to live in Indonesia and revive a nursing home of Grandmother's relics. A beautiful nurse, Wulan (Wulan Guritno) who lives not far from Villa Rose proposes to be the person in charge of the institution to be opened. Wulan brings helpers to take care of the villas and all the inhabitants. The problem arose when Maya (Ardina Rasti) also suddenly appeared in Villa Rose. Maya is Joe's quirky and mysterious brother. Sarah sensed anomalies but no one else felt the same way. He was determined to reveal everything.
